content.title: Georgia football spring game: Highlights as red team wins
content.text: Updated April 18, 2026, 3:24 p.m. ETThe Georgia Bulldogs played in their annual spring game, G-Day, at Sanford Stadium. The red team defeated the black team 27-17. The first-team offense (red team) did a better job of moving the ball than the black team (first-team defense).Georgia quarterback Gunner Stockton did not play a ton in the game, but played pretty well. Running back Nate Frazier left the game after one carry. He appeared to suffer an ankle injury and did not return.Tight end Jaden Reddell scored a touchdown and had a nice day. Georgia had seven different quarterbacks take snaps. Running backs Dante Dowdell and Dwight Phillips both had touchdowns. Fellow running back Chauncey Bowens also impressed.Georgia had several notable players out for the scrimmage with injuries including center Drew Bobo, edge Amaris Williams, cornerback Ellis Robinson and defensive end Gabe Harris. Georgia had over 30 elite recruits in attendance for the game.Georgia fans watched as defending SEC champions had tons of players make their Sanford Stadium debut. Nine transfers and 28 of the Dawgs' class of 2026 early enrollees got their first taste of G-Day as a member of the team.Official attendance for G-Day is 31,023. We've gone a long way from having over 90,000 fans at the spring game. Final: Red team 27, Black team 17Hezekiah Millender leads the black offense down the field, but it does not result in points. He often looks for tight end Ethan Barbour. Freshman defensive back Tyriq Green showed off his instincts on an interception. Ryan Puglisi hands the ball off to Dante Dowdell to end the game. Red team 27, Black team 17: Fourth quarterBeaver connects on a pass to Kaiden Prothro for the black team to help move down the field. Prothro, who offensive coordinator Mike Bobo considers to be a wide receiver and not a tight end, caught a touchdown pass. Beaver put together a few strong drives. Georgia has a huge quarterback room right now. Red team 27, Black team 10: Fourth quarterAfter a punt (drive quarterbacked by Ryan Puglisi), Ryan Montgomery hits Colton Heinrich, who comes up with a one-handed catch for 53 yards. Landon Roldan makes a nice catch. Running back Dante Dowdell plunges in for a touchdown. Red team 20, Black team 10: Fourth quarterHarran Zureikat kicks a field goal after Bryson Beaver helped put UGA in field goal range. The black team needed to score a touchdown on this red zone trip. Start of the fourth quarter: Red team 20, Black team 7Red team defensive back Blake Stewart intercepts quarterback Colter Ginn. Stewart has made a few plays on G-Day. Red team freshman quarterback Bryson Beaver completes a long pass to end the third quarter. Red team 20, Black team 7: Third quarterDante Dowdell had another great run for the red team. CJ Wiley had a 26-yard reception to help set up Georgia for a 38-yard Peyton Woodring field goal. Ryan Montgomery quarterbacked the drive for the red team. The black team strikes: Red team 17, Black team 7The second half will go by fast as there is a running clock. Georgia red team linebackers Elijah Littlejohn and Nick Abrams have had a good scrimmage. However, they allowed the Black Team to score a touchdown. Hezekiah Millender scored a one-yard rushing touchdown and connected with tight end Brayden Fogle on third-down for a long pass earlier in the drive. Halftime: Red team 17, Black team 0Red team defensive back Todd Robinson picks off black team quarterback Ryan Montgomery on an overthrown deep pass. Black team quarterback Gunner Stockton gets sacked and throws an incompletion as the black team is forced to punt, but the punt is fumbled by Tyriq Green. The fumble went into the end zone, but Kirby Smart wanted to five the black team a chance to score. Hezekiah Millender got some late action for the black team. Harran Zureikat missed a 48-yard field goal to end the half.Kirby Smart talked about how windy it was on the field at halftime. He emphasized that the black team needs better quarterback play. Red team 17, Black team 0: 1:31 left in the second quarterReceiver Talyn Taylor, who has had a good spring, hauled in a 32-yard pass from quarterback Ryan Puglisi for the black team. Puglisi is much more productive for the black team than the red team. Defensive back Gentry Williams is in a noncontact jersey. Running back Dwight Phillips punched in a one-yard rushing touchdown. Second quarter: Red team 10, Black team 0Linebacker Nick Abrams had a pass deflection on third down to force a third consecutive black team punt. The red team had another punt on quarterback Ryan Puglisi's first drive of the game. Puglisi had a third-down pass batted down by defensive lineman Xzavier McLeod.The black team and Ryan Montgomery had a nice drive brewing. Kentucky transfer running back Dante Dowdell had a nice 27-yard rush with a big stiff arm, but Montgomery had a fourth-down pass fall incomplete after freshman defensive back Black Stewart had a pass break up. Red team 10, Black team 0: Second quarterTight end Jaden Reddell had a big drive. He hauled in a seven-yard touchdown pass from red team quarterback Gunner Stockton and had a 23-yard rush on a jet sweep, where he got a nice block from tight end Elyiss Williams. Red team 3, Black team 0: End of the first quarterAfter a second black team punt (quarterback Ryan Montgomery led the drive), the red team had a nice gain from running back Chauncey Bowens. The black defensive front has gotten the better of the red offensive line thus far. Red team 3, Black team 0: Gunner Stockton leads UGA to field goalRed team running back Dwight Phillips had a 15 yard carry and freshman receiver Craig Dandridge had another chunk play to help the Bulldogs get a 33-yard Peyton Woodring field goal. Joseph Jonah-Ajonje and Chris Cole both had pressures for the black team defense. Black team opening drive is a three-and-outThe black team and second-string quarterback Ryan Puglisi were stopped on their opening drive. Red team defenders Nnamdi Ogboko (sack) and Ja'Marley Riddle (tackle) made key plays for the defense. Red team's opening drive is a puntThe red team receives the opening kickoff. On the first play, Georgia handed the ball off to running back Nate Frazier, who limped off the field with an ankle injury. Sideline reporter D.J. Shockley added that Frazier's injury did not seem serious. Cornerback Braylon Conley, a USC transfer, breaks up a pass intended for Georgia Tech transfer receiver Isiah Canion. The black team forced a Georgia punt. Georgia's red and black teamsWhat channel is Georgia's spring game on today?TV Channel: ESPN+Livestream: ESPN+/SEC Network+The Georgia spring game will broadcast on ESPN+ and SEC Network+. Scott Howard and Josh Brock will call the scrimmage from the booth at Sanford Stadium for the Georgia Bulldogs radio network, with D.J. Shockley reporting from the sidelines. Streaming options for the game are limited to ESPN+ and SEC Network+.Georgia spring game time todayDate: Saturday, April 18Start time: 1 p.m. ETThe G-Day game starts at 1 p.m. ET from Sanford Stadium in Athens, Georgia.Follow UGA Wire on Instagram or Threads for more Georgia football coverage!
